verification.direction: count-once charges what we actually spent; SPARROW charges only what hindsight needed, so our published cost is conservative
verification.source: Logs/049 + its re-audit recorded in RESEARCH_CONTEXT
verification.caveat: DRD2 at K=20 reads 12.69%, traced entirely to pre-select-K's 26 up-front reactions (~17 unused by a 100-mode selection); at K=0 it is exactly 0.00% (110/110)

footnotes: We are also exploring giving the retrosynthesis pipeline a diversity-enforced candidate pool rather than the highest-scoring one; those results are not yet included.

A selection-only control on DRD2 isolates the chooser from the candidates: handing SPARROW our own enumerated children -- a byte-identical pool, verified by digest -- it recovers 28 and 15 distinct molecules across two seeds against our 78, both solves optimal. Our arm sees only already-stocked fragments while SPARROW sees the whole enumeration, so that margin is a lower bound.
